parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4)
Aquifer depth: 9.665 m to >47.738 m (Layers 3 and 4, resistivity 4591.4–5101.5 Ω·m)
Recommendation: The high-resistivity sequence below 9.665 m indicates a thick, clean sand/sandstone aquifer; drilling should target this zone from approximately 10 m to beyond 47.7 m depth, with casing set through the shallow low-resistivity clayey overburden (0–9.665 m) to prevent sediment influx and ensure a stable, productive well screen interval.
